1.source: Rewritten 2026-11-21 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text followed modern Bibles in many places), following the KJV's Greek text (Textus Receptus, checked against Moorman's 8,000 Differences), at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses.

verses.text: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained like precious faith with us, through the righteousness of God and our Savior Jesus Christ:
Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord.
God's divine power has given to us all things that pertain to life and godliness. This is through the knowledge of the One who has called us to glory and virtue (goodness).

By this are given to us exceeding great and precious promises. By these you might be partakers (sharers) of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption (rot) that is in the world through lust (wrong desire).
And besides this, giving all diligence (hard work), add to your faith virtue (goodness), and to virtue (goodness) knowledge,
And to knowledge temperance (self-control), and to temperance (self-control) patience, and to patience godliness,
And to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness charity (love).
For if these things are in you, and abound (grow), they make you so that you will be neither barren (empty) nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
But the one who lacks these things is blind, and cannot see far off. He has forgotten that he was purged (washed clean) from his old sins.
So, brothers, give more diligence (hard work) to make your calling and election (being chosen) sure. For if you do these things, you will never fall.
For so an entrance will be given to you abundantly (richly) into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
So I will not be negligent (careless) to put you always in remembrance of these things, though you know them, and are established (made firm) in the present truth.
Yes, I think it right, as long as I am in this tabernacle (tent, meaning my body), to stir you up by putting you in remembrance.
I know that shortly I must put off this tabernacle (tent, meaning my body), even as our Lord Jesus Christ has showed me.
Also I will try hard that after my decease (death) you may be able to have these things always in remembrance.

For we have not followed cunningly devised fables (clever made-up stories) when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. But we were eyewitnesses of His majesty (greatness).
For Jesus received from God the Father honor and glory, when there came such a voice to Him from the excellent glory: This is My beloved (dear) Son, in whom I am well pleased.
And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with Jesus in the holy mount (mountain).

We have also a more sure word of prophecy. You do well to take heed (pay attention) to it, as to a light that shines in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star (morning star) arise in your hearts.
Know this first: no prophecy of the Scripture is of any private interpretation (comes from the prophet's own explaining).
For the prophecy did not come in old time by the will of man. But holy men of God spoke as they were moved (carried along) by the Holy Spirit.

V4 'hell' is Greek Tartarus, kept as 'hell' per the site's rule.

verses.text: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly bring in damnable heresies (wrong teachings that destroy), even denying the Lord who bought them. And they will bring on themselves swift destruction.
And many will follow their pernicious (destructive) ways. Because of them the way of truth will be evil spoken of.

And through covetousness (greed) they will with feigned (made-up) words make merchandise of you (use you to make money). Their judgment now for a long time does not linger (wait), and their damnation (being condemned) does not slumber (sleep).
For God did not spare the angels that sinned. But God cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved (kept) for judgment.
And God did not spare the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness (what is right), bringing in the flood on the world of the ungodly.

And God turned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha (Gomorrah) into ashes, and condemned (judged guilty) them with an overthrow (destruction). God made them an example to those who after would live ungodly.
And God delivered (rescued) just (righteous) Lot, who was vexed (troubled) with the filthy conversation (way of life) of the wicked.
For that righteous man, living among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed (troubled) his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds.
The Lord knows how to deliver (rescue) the godly out of temptations (trials). And He knows how to reserve (keep) the unjust to the day of judgment to be punished.

But chiefly (most of all) He will punish those who walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness (dirty desires), and despise government (authority). They are presumptuous (too bold) and selfwilled. They are not afraid to speak evil of dignities (those in high places).
Yet angels, who are greater in power and might, do not bring railing (insulting) accusation against them before the Lord.
But these men, as natural brute (wild) beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they do not understand. And they will utterly perish in their own corruption (rot).

They will receive the reward of unrighteousness (wrong), as those who count it pleasure to riot (party wildly) in the day time. They are spots and blemishes (stains), sporting themselves (having fun) with their own deceivings (lies) while they feast with you.

They have eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease (stop) from sin. They beguile (trick) unstable souls. They have a heart exercised (trained) with covetous practices (greedy ways). They are cursed children.
They have forsaken (left) the right way, and are gone astray (wandered off). They follow the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages (pay) of unrighteousness (wrong).
But Balaam was rebuked (corrected) for his iniquity (sin). The dumb (speechless) donkey speaking with man's voice forbad (stopped) the madness of the prophet.
These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest (storm). The mist of darkness is reserved (kept) for them forever.

For when they speak great swelling (proud) words of vanity (emptiness), they allure (pull in) through the lusts (wrong desires) of the flesh, through much wantonness (wild living), those who were clean escaped from those who live in error (wrong).
They promise them liberty (freedom), while they themselves are the servants (slaves) of corruption (rot). For whatever overcomes a man, by the same he is brought into bondage (slavery).

For if, after they have escaped the pollutions (dirt) of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again tangled in them and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
For it would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness (what is right), than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered (handed) to them.

But it has happened to them according to the true proverb (saying): The dog has turned to his own vomit again. And: The sow (pig) that was washed has gone back to her wallowing (rolling) in the mire (mud).

verses.text: This second epistle (letter), beloved (dear friends), I now write to you. In both of them I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance.
I want you to be mindful (remember) of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Savior.
Know this first: there will come in the last days scoffers (mockers), walking after their own lusts (wrong desires),
And saying: Where is the promise of His coming? For since the fathers fell asleep (died), all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
For they are willingly ignorant (choose not to know) of this: by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water.
By this the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished.
But the heavens and the earth which are now, by the same word, are kept in store, reserved (kept) for fire against the day of judgment and perdition (destruction) of ungodly men.
But, beloved (dear friends), do not be ignorant (not knowing) of this one thing: one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

The Lord is not slack (slow) about His promise, as some men count slackness (slowness). But He is longsuffering (patient) to us-ward (toward us). He is not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance (a change of heart).

But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night. In it the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will melt with fervent (burning) heat. The earth also and the works that are in it will be burned up.
Seeing then that all these things will be dissolved (destroyed), what kind of persons ought you to be in all holy conversation (way of life) and godliness,

Looking for and hasting to (hurrying toward) the coming of the day of God? In that day the heavens, being on fire, will be dissolved (destroyed), and the elements will melt with fervent (burning) heat.
But we, according to His promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, in which dwells (lives) righteousness (what is right).
So, beloved (dear friends), seeing that you look for such things, be diligent (work hard) that you may be found by Him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
And count that the longsuffering (patience) of our Lord is salvation. Even as our beloved (dear) brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, has written to you.

As also in all his epistles (letters), Paul speaks in them of these things. In them are some things hard to be understood. Those who are unlearned and unstable wrest (twist) them, as they do also the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
So, beloved (dear friends), seeing you know these things before, beware. Do not be led away with the error (wrong) of the wicked, and fall from your own stedfastness (firmness).
But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be glory both now and forever. Amen.
